title: Route to an email contact
prompt: A customer has a name, a primary contact, and an optional backup contact. Each contact has a kind and an address. Route to the primary contact's address when its kind is exactly "email". Otherwise route to the backup contact's address when a backup is present and its kind is exactly "email". If neither applies the result is an error "no email contact for <name>". Return the chosen address and whether the backup was used.

cases.name: primary-email
cases.trap: the target is the address inside the contact, not the contact itself

cases.name: absent-backup
cases.trap: an absent backup has no fields to read; it must be checked for presence before its kind

cases.name: kind-is-case-sensitive
cases.trap: kind matching is exact; "Email" is not "email"

cases.name: primary-wins-over-backup
cases.trap: when both contacts are email the primary is chosen and the backup flag stays false
